name: Kuya
source:
Revered by the beasts of the forest, Kuya is a magical fox who through years and years of exposure to essence gradually gained a human form. A lover of all things new and exciting, he loathes nothing more than being bored. Specialized in creating illusions, he utilizes them to toy with others for his own personal pleasure.

[From the [url=https://nucarnival.com/en-US/Characters/Kuya]official website[/url]]
